# QueueLens

> QueueLens is a free, open-source, browser-based analyzer for customer-support ticket CSV exports. It reports SLA estimates (calendar hours), backlog aging, agent workload and data quality. All processing happens locally in the browser; no data is uploaded.

- URL: https://manayab.github.io/Queue-Lens/
- Source: https://github.com/MANayab/Queue-Lens
- Audience: support managers, operations analysts, BPO teams (3-30 agents)
- Works with CSV exports from Zendesk, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management, Help Scout and others (manual column mapping)
- Backlog buckets: Fresh 0-24h, Aging 24-48h, At risk 48-72h, Critical 72h+
- SLA statuses: Met, Breached, On track, Overdue, Not measurable, Needs review
- Limits: calendar hours only; no business hours, holidays or pause-on-pending; estimates are not official helpdesk SLA values
- Price: free, no account
